desc_en: Te-dominant: outstanding execution and organizational ability, skilled at mobilizing resources and driving goals forward. Ni-auxiliary provides strategic vision — born to lead teams and tackle hard problems, with a low tolerance for chaos and inefficiency.
desc_zh: Te 主导：执行力与组织力突出，善于调动资源、推进目标。Ni 辅助提供战略眼光，天生适合带团队和攻坚，讨厌失控与低效。
